Markets.title: Donald Trump bought up to $50,000 worth SpaceX shares in June, financial disclosure shows
Markets.summary: President Donald Trump invested up to $50,000 in Elon Musk's SpaceX on June 23. Independent third-party institutions manage the president's investment portfolio.

Markets.title: Gold rallies past three-month high as Treasury buyback and weak dollar boost demand
Markets.summary: Gold prices hit a three-month high on Monday due to a weaker U.S. dollar and a Treasury buyback. The rally was further driven by technical buying and strong exchange-traded fund inflows.

Markets.title: Sebi drops proceedings against Max Financial, Axis Bank in Max Life deal case
Markets.summary: Capital markets regulator Sebi has dropped proceedings against Max Financial Services and Axis Bank entities regarding a Max Life insurance deal. Sebi concluded that allegations of disclosure lapses and a fraudulent scheme involving transactions from FY10 to FY22 were not established.

Markets.title: India's house price growth slows to 3.6% in Q1 FY27: RBI
Markets.summary: India's annual house price growth slowed to 3.6 percent in the first quarter of fiscal year 2027, down from 4.5 percent in the previous quarter. Despite this yearly deceleration, the All-India House Price Index rose 1.1 percent from the prior quarter, driven largely by contributions from Chandigarh and Lucknow.

Markets.title: SoftBank pares nearly 2.6% stake in Lenskart for Rs 2,888 crore
Markets.summary: SoftBank Group sold a 2.6% stake in Lenskart for Rs 2,888 crore through a block deal involving multiple institutional investors. This transaction reduced SoftBank's holding in the company from 9.86% to 7.28%.

Markets.title: Ahead of Market: 10 things that will decide stock market action on Tuesday
Markets.summary: Indian equities closed lower on Monday due to rising bond yields, Iran sanctions uncertainty, and weak Asian markets. Analysts expect market volatility to continue on Tuesday.

Geo-Political.title: Iran faces 'greatest financial offensive ever', says US treasury secretary
Geo-Political.summary: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent announced that the United States will completely sever economic ties with Iran in a major financial offensive. He also stated that any nation continuing to partner financially with Iran will face international isolation.

Geo-Political.title: UK PM Burnham vows support for Ukraine despite 'outrageous threats' from Russia
Geo-Political.summary: British Prime Minister Burnham has pledged continued support for Ukraine following Russian warnings of consequences over the reported use of British drones. Moscow had issued outrageous threats regarding Ukraine's military actions involving British-supplied equipment.

Geo-Political.title: Russia's second-biggest online retailer targeted in Ukrainian strikes
Geo-Political.summary: Overnight Ukrainian strikes targeted warehouses belonging to Ozon, Russia's second-biggest online retailer. The affected facilities are located across southern Russia, including in Dagestan and Krasnodar.

Geo-Political.title: Israel warns of 'forceful' response to kites flown from Gaza
Geo-Political.summary: Israel has threatened a forceful response to kites carrying incendiary devices that have been flown across the border from the Gaza Strip. Hamas claims that these kites were launched by children within Gaza.

Geo-Political.title: King of Norway's health has worsened, palace says
Geo-Political.summary: Norway's King Harald remains hospitalized for a bloodstream bacterial infection. The royal palace reports that his health has worsened.

Geo-Political.title: Outrage in Nepal over rape and murder of three-year-old girl
Geo-Political.summary: Protests have erupted in Nepal following the rape and murder of a three-year-old girl. The victim was found dead last week, three days after she was reported missing.

Data & Insights.title: Scott Bessent eying US Treasury cashpile, could use $1 trillion General Account for debt buybacks, says report
Data & Insights.summary: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent is reportedly considering using the department's $1 trillion General Account to fund buybacks of older, higher-yielding securities. This strategy, cited by two senior officials according to CNBC, aims to restructure government debt.

Data & Insights.title: India negotiating trade deals with nations, blocs worth $15 trillion GDP: Piyush Goyal
Data & Insights.summary: Indian Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal stated that India is negotiating trade agreements with countries and blocs representing a combined $15 trillion GDP. Goyal announced this during a visit to Japan, where he is leading a delegation of over 200 business representatives to enhance bilateral trade and investment.

Data & Insights.title: Iranian rial hits record low of 2.02 million against US dollar amid threat of new Trump sanctions — Here's what we know
Data & Insights.summary: On August 24, the Iranian rial fell 4.5% to a record low of 2.02 million against the US dollar. This currency drop occurred after US President Donald Trump announced a new "crushing economic operation" against Tehran.

Data & Insights.title: Service producer prices index mixed in Q1; air passenger services surge 32%
Data & Insights.summary: The government released mixed service producer price indices for the first quarter using a 2022-23 base year, noting that aggregate weights were not assigned because the data does not cover the entire sector. Within the report, air passenger services experienced a significant surge of 32%.

Data & Insights.title: AI, semicon, global value chains: How globalization isn't dying—it's evolving
Data & Insights.summary: Global trade is shifting away from physical goods toward services and strategic technologies like semiconductors and AI. Rather than disappearing, globalization is reconfiguring its supply chains and capital flows.

Data & Insights.title: The week in charts: Hawkish RBI minutes, drought warning, rural workforce
Data & Insights.summary: This weekly compilation uses easy-to-read charts to present data-based insights on stories reported by Mint. Key topics covered this week include hawkish Reserve Bank of India minutes, a drought warning, and the rural workforce.

India.title: Akali Dal Spell Checks Classroom Posters, AAP's 'Hatred For Punjab' Reply
India.summary: The Shiromani Akali Dal used sarcasm to criticize a government minister regarding errors on classroom posters. In response, the Aam Aadmi Party accused the opposition of showing hatred toward Punjab.

India.title: Video: School Buses Stranded On Flooded Gurugram Roads, Students Trapped
India.summary: Severe waterlogging at Subhash Chowk in Gurugram trapped several school buses carrying children on flooded streets for hours. The heavy flooding occurred throughout the city's affected areas, leaving the vehicles stranded.

India.title: Amazon, Swiggy, BigBasket Lose Food Licences Over 'Datura' Sales In Karnataka
India.summary: Karnataka authorities suspended the food licenses of Amazon, Swiggy, and BigBasket for selling products containing datura. In response, BigBasket stopped selling the fruits online, while Amazon and Swiggy failed to provide timely compliance documents.

India.title: Exclusive: Malayalam Actor Says TVK Offered Him Top Post In Kerala After He Quit BJP
India.summary: Malayalam actor Devan resigned from the BJP on August 16 after stating he was not given a meaningful role during his nearly five years in the party. Following his resignation, he revealed that Vijay's TVK party offered him a top leadership position in Kerala.

India.title: Class 1 Student Hospitalised After Snakebite In Kolkata Government School
India.summary: A Class 1 student at a Kolkata government school was hospitalised after being bitten by a snake. School authorities took the child to SSKM Hospital, where he remains admitted under observation.

India.title: Protests In Manipur Over Inclusion Of 2 Non-Muslim Members In Waqf Board
India.summary: Protests are occurring in Manipur because the state government included two non-Muslim members in the Waqf Board. Organisers have warned of further agitation across the state if the government does not reconsider the board's composition.

General.title: Organised crime arrests as police investigate A66 crash that killed two officers
General.summary: Police investigating a crash on the A66 that killed two officers and five others have arrested nine men and three women. The suspects were detained as part of an organised crime investigation into the events leading up to the fatal collision.

General.title: How the deadly A66 crash unfolded leaving seven dead
General.summary: At 03:30 BST on Saturday, a Volkswagen Passat collided with a marked police car on the A66 motorway. The crash resulted in seven deaths, including two police officers.

General.title: World's oceans hit highest temperature on record as El Niño grows
General.summary: The world's oceans have reached their highest temperature on record as the El Niño climate pattern intensifies. Scientists describe this milestone as a clear signal that marine environments are under growing stress.
